name: Teeth Whitening
tagline: A brighter smile in a single session
summary: Professional in-clinic whitening using safe, clinically proven systems that lift stains and brighten your smile — perfect before a big event or trip home.

faq.q: How white will my teeth get?
faq.a: Results vary by baseline shade and lifestyle, but most patients see several shades of improvement after one session.

faq.q: Is it safe for sensitive teeth?
faq.a: Clinics use desensitising agents and adjust strength to your comfort. Tell your dentist about any sensitivity first.
